integrity.title: Integrity (schema, citations, duplicates, references, identifier stability)

checks.label: All records pass schema validation
Archive compiles (citations resolve to documents)
Every deal cites at least one primary source
Every material amount has claim-level evidence
No duplicate transactions (same parties and announcement date)
Cross-references resolve (unresolved ones are dropped at compile time, not shown as links)
Transaction multiples record their denominator period, accounting basis and perimeter
Claim IDs stable: every registered ID still describes the same claim (research/claim-registry.json)
Claim values changed at an existing ID since last registered (logged under revisions in the registry)
Source documents marked unavailable (kept with provenance, flagged)
